title: Frontier / Release rhythm
scope: Selected public main-family named model launches from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google (PaLM 2 and Gemini), DeepSeek and Meta. Not a complete industry census or benchmark ranking; burst heights use Epoch AI's ECI for the matching released version.

releases.name: LLaMA
releases.note: 7B/13B/33B/65B grouped. Research-only noncommercial, application-based weights; included as first public introduction under the same request-access precedent as Claude and Gemini 1.5 Pro. Not universal availability.

releases.name: Claude
releases.note: Initial public introduction; access initially offered via partners and requests.

releases.name: Claude Instant
releases.note: Introduced alongside Claude as a separately named faster general-purpose model.

releases.name: PaLM 2
releases.note: Introduced in Bard and the PaLM API that day; Google main family before Gemini. Publicly shipped size versus Epoch PaLM 2-L/M/S score correspondence to be confirmed; left unscored.

releases.name: Llama 2
releases.note: 7B/13B/70B base/chat grouped; 70B tier ECI. Custom Llama 2 Community License permits qualified commercial use; open weights does not imply OSI open source.

releases.name: Claude Instant 1.2
releases.note: Epoch Claude Instant is dated 2023-08-09, matching the 1.2 release; exact version identification to be confirmed.

releases.name: DeepSeek LLM
releases.note: 7B and 67B base/chat grouped; ECI maps the 67B tier. Release date corroborated by first official GitHub commit on November 29 and official Hugging Face repository creation the same day. Code MIT; weights use the DeepSeek Model License.

releases.name: Gemini 1.0 Pro
releases.note: Pro available in Bard from launch day; Gemini API followed Dec 13. Nano is excluded as on-device-only. Ultra was announced here but released later.

releases.name: Gemini Ultra 1.0
releases.note: First public availability of the Ultra tier, via the paid Gemini Advanced plan; the same-day Bard rename is not counted.

releases.name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
releases.note: Limited preview by sign-up in AI Studio and Vertex AI; public API preview Apr 9 and GA May 23, 2024 are not counted again.

releases.name: Claude 3 Opus
releases.note: Opus released on March 4; Haiku arrived later.

releases.name: Claude 3 Sonnet
releases.note: Sonnet released alongside Claude 3 Opus on March 4; Haiku arrived later.

releases.name: Claude 3 Haiku
releases.note: March 4 was an announcement of future availability; use the March 13 public release. Epoch dates this checkpoint March 7.

releases.name: Llama 3
releases.note: 8B/70B grouped; not the later 405B release. Custom Llama 3 Community License.

releases.name: DeepSeek V2
releases.note: 236B MoE main model; official repository News states May 6. Hugging Face repository was created April 28, before the announced release; repository creation alone is not the launch date. Weights under DeepSeek Model License. Epoch CSV dates the same May version May 7; official release date May 6 controls the x-coordinate.

releases.name: Gemini 1.5 Flash
releases.note: Public preview at I/O on May 14; the API changelog records a May 10 preview, so the first-public date is to be confirmed. Epoch dates the May checkpoint May 23.

releases.name: DeepSeek V2-Lite
releases.note: Official repository News dates release May 16. Separately named small V2 tier with Chat and public weights.

releases.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet
releases.note: API release log dates availability June 20; the news page currently displays June 21.

releases.name: GPT-4o mini
releases.note: Separately named small general-purpose GPT-4o tier.

releases.name: Llama 3.1
releases.note: 8B/70B/405B grouped, using the 405B tier. Custom Llama 3.1 Community License.

releases.name: DeepSeek V2.5
releases.note: Merged general chat and coding capabilities in the main general-purpose model, not a separate Coder event. No matching ECI entry; do not substitute V2 or V3.

releases.name: o1-mini
releases.note: Released alongside o1-preview; this model is a release even though the other model is a preview.

releases.name: Llama 3.2
releases.note: 1B/3B text and 11B/90B general multimodal language models grouped; use 90B, not only the smaller text tier. Vision input does not turn a general-purpose LLM into an image generator. Custom Llama 3.2 Community License. Epoch CSV dates the model September 24; official announcement and model card say September 25, which controls the x-coordinate.

releases.name: Claude 3.5 Sonnet v2
releases.note: v2 is an editorial label for the explicitly announced upgraded Sonnet.

releases.name: Claude 3.5 Haiku

sources.title: Claude 3.5 Haiku — official API release notes

releases.note: October 22 announced future availability; the API release log records November 4 availability. Epoch dates the checkpoint October 22.

releases.name: DeepSeek R1-Lite-Preview
releases.note: First public preview of the main reasoning family, usable on the web that day; API and weights were only promised. Included as preview despite Lite in the name because it introduced the family, rather than an auxiliary smaller tier. No matching ECI entry.

releases.name: o1
releases.note: Production o1 replaces the separately named o1-preview; pro compute mode is not counted again.

releases.name: Llama 3.3
releases.note: 70B general multilingual text model; date stated by model card and Community License. No separate 405B event.

releases.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
releases.note: New generation opened with experimental Flash; its API general availability on Feb 5, 2025 is not counted again.

releases.name: DeepSeek V3
releases.note: 671B MoE, 37B active; base/chat weights under DeepSeek Model License and code MIT. Model card and API log both date the release December 26.

releases.name: DeepSeek R1
releases.note: Main 671B reasoning model, MIT weights. R1-Zero research checkpoint and six distilled models do not add events or supply the score.

releases.name: o3-mini
releases.note: Separately named small general-purpose reasoning tier.

releases.name: Gemini 2.0 Pro
releases.note: Experimental Pro preview. Same-day Gemini 2.0 Flash GA adds availability to the existing Flash model and is excluded.

releases.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash-Lite
releases.note: Public Flash-Lite preview. No exact matching ECI CSV row. Same-day Gemini 2.0 Flash GA is an availability addition and is excluded.

releases.name: DeepSeek V3-0324
releases.note: Explicit major reasoning and tool-use upgrade, not a routine snapshot. Use March 24 from the official API change log; the standalone news post is dated March 25. MIT weights. This one-day discrepancy is preserved.

releases.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
releases.note: Experimental at launch; updated previews on May 6 and Jun 5 and stable GA on Jun 17, 2025 are not counted again.

releases.name: Llama 4 Maverick
releases.note: Maverick publicly released on April 5; Epoch CSV dates it April 6. Custom Llama 4 Community License. Unreleased Behemoth excluded.

releases.name: Llama 4 Scout
releases.note: Scout publicly released alongside Maverick on April 5. Custom Llama 4 Community License. Unreleased Behemoth excluded.

releases.name: GPT-4.1
releases.note: API launch; later ChatGPT availability is not counted again.

releases.name: GPT-4.1 mini
releases.note: Separately named small tier released alongside GPT-4.1 and nano.

releases.name: GPT-4.1 nano
releases.note: Separately named smallest tier released alongside GPT-4.1 and mini.

releases.name: o3
releases.note: o3 released alongside the separately named o4-mini.

releases.name: o4-mini
releases.note: o4-mini released alongside o3.

releases.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
releases.note: Public preview of the separately named fast general-purpose tier; use the April checkpoint.

releases.name: Claude Opus 4
releases.note: Opus 4 released alongside Sonnet 4.

releases.name: Claude Sonnet 4
releases.note: Sonnet 4 released alongside Opus 4.

releases.name: DeepSeek R1-0528
releases.note: Explicit major reasoning revision with benchmark gains and added JSON/function calling. MIT; the distilled Qwen3-8B is excluded.

releases.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
releases.note: Public preview of the separately named lightweight tier; use the June checkpoint.

releases.name: GPT-5 mini
releases.note: Separately named small tier released alongside GPT-5 and nano.

releases.name: GPT-5 nano
releases.note: Separately named smallest tier released alongside GPT-5 and mini.

releases.name: DeepSeek V3.1
releases.note: Unified hybrid thinking/non-thinking main model; MIT weights. Thinking and non-thinking are modes of the same version, counted as one model with the matching ECI V3.1 entry.

releases.name: DeepSeek V3.2-Exp
releases.note: Public experimental preview introducing DeepSeek Sparse Attention. API and MIT weights available, not a closed evaluation.

releases.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
releases.note: Separately named fast general-purpose Haiku tier.

releases.name: GPT-5.1
releases.note: Instant and Thinking are modes of the same version, counted as one model.

releases.name: GPT-5.1 Instant
releases.note: Announcement explicitly names Instant and Thinking; API model gpt-5.1-chat-latest. No exact ECI row.

releases.name: Gemini 3 Pro
releases.note: API model labelled preview and never made GA; Gemini app rollout began the same day. Deep Think mode is excluded.

releases.name: DeepSeek V3.2

sources.title: DeepSeek V3.2 Speciale — official weights and model card

releases.note: General V3.2 replaced V3.2-Exp in the app, web and API; uses the exact DeepSeek-V3.2 ECI row. Speciale is excluded as a compute-only reasoning mode, like Deep Think / Pro. Its official source is retained as evidence for this distinction.

releases.name: GPT-5.2 Instant
releases.note: Explicitly named in the announcement; API model gpt-5.2-chat-latest. No exact ECI row.

releases.name: Gemini 3 Flash
releases.note: API model gemini-3-flash-preview; marked preview consistently with Gemini 3 Pro.

releases.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
releases.note: Released in preview in the API and Gemini app; no GA entry in the Gemini API release notes through Oct 2, 2026.

releases.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite
releases.note: First public preview; May 7 general availability is not counted again.

releases.name: GPT-5.4 mini
releases.note: Separately named small general-purpose tier released with nano.

releases.name: GPT-5.4 nano
releases.note: Separately named smallest general-purpose tier released with mini.

releases.name: Muse Spark

sources.title: Muse Spark — official announcement / model card

releases.note: MSL main general-purpose multimodal reasoning family, closed weights; publicly usable in Meta AI that day. Private API preview is not a second launch. Open-weight-only filtering would miss this successor.

releases.name: GPT-5.5
releases.note: ChatGPT/Codex rollout; the API followed April 24.

releases.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro
releases.note: Public Pro preview; uses the April checkpoint rather than the August revision. Million-token context and new architecture; MIT weights. Model card publication April 27 follows the April 24 launch.

releases.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash
releases.note: Public Flash preview alongside V4 Pro; uses its own Flash checkpoint. Million-token context and new architecture; MIT weights. Model card publication April 27 follows the April 24 launch.

releases.name: GPT-5.5 Instant
releases.note: Separately named general-purpose Instant release.

releases.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
releases.note: Gemini 3.5 family opened with GA Flash; 3.5 Pro, promised for the next month, was still unreleased on Oct 2, 2026.

releases.name: Claude Fable 5
releases.note: Public Fable model counted; restricted Mythos counterpart excluded.

releases.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
releases.note: Sol tier at general release; earlier closed partner preview excluded.

releases.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
releases.note: Terra tier at general release; earlier closed partner preview excluded.

releases.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
releases.note: Luna tier at general release; earlier closed partner preview excluded.

releases.note: Main Spark revision available via API and Muse Code. Coding-focused training retains general-agent capability; included as a main-family update, unlike a separate Codex/Code Llama specialized branch. Closed weights.

releases.name: Muse Glimmer
releases.note: Separately named small Muse tier: 30B, public weights, general dialogue, reasoning and tool use. No exact ECI row.

releases.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash

releases.name: DeepSeek V4 Pro-0813
releases.note: Explicit substantially retrained Pro GA revision on web/app/API, not merely removal of the preview label; match the August ECI entry, not April preview.

releases.name: Claude Fable 5.1
releases.note: Public Fable model counted; restricted Mythos counterpart excluded.

releases.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
releases.note: Counted as a new version number; restricted 3.8 Flash Cyber (Fairwind Program) is not counted.

releases.name: Muse Spark 1.3

sources.title: Muse Spark 1.3 — official announcement / model card

releases.note: Main general agentic/coding update, closed weights. Use September 2 original release, not September 24 additional cloud-platform availability.

releases.name: GPT-6 Astra
releases.note: Official start of staged rollout; date also listed in the GPT-6.1 Sol article.

releases.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash
releases.note: New main architecture generation with native vision understanding and general reasoning/agents. Flash introduces V4.1, following the Gemini Flash new-version rule; not an auxiliary Lite tier. The launch news says V4 Pro would route away on September 14; the current API log instead records continued V4 Pro service. This availability correction is not another model launch. Epoch CSV date September 9 differs from official September 10 launch; use the official publisher date.

Gemini Apps release notes — October 13 public rollout

releases.name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017
releases.note: Explicit major post-training release using reinforcement learning with self-feedback and broad benchmark gains, plus new weights. Included despite dated suffix, like V3-0324/R1-0528; not the separate Search/Fetch product launch. No matching ECI entry; never reuse September V4.1 Flash score.
